main_text.l: וַיִּשְׁחוּ [?] et incurvati sunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁחַח.
יִשָּׁחֵט [?] jugulabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. שָׁחַט.
וְיִשְׁחֲךָ [?] & depressio tua, f. m. aff. No. Rad. שָׁחַח depressio.
יַשְׁחֶנָּה [?] deprimet illam, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. שָׁחָה.
יִשְׁחֲרֻנִי [?] tempestive quaerent me, Prov. 1. 28. pro יִשְׁחֲרוּנִי, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. שָׁחַר.
יִשְׁטֶּה [?] declinabit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoe (pro יִשְׁטֶּה,) Rad. שָׁטָה.
וַיִּשְׁטוּ [?] & discurrerunt, יִשְׁטוּ [?] percurrent, fut. Kal & Piel, 3. pl. m. Rad. שׁוּט.
וַיִּשְׂטְמוּ [?] & odit, וַיִּשְׂטְמֻהוּ [?] & oderunt eum, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. שָׂטַם.
inundabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. שָׁטַף.
יִשָּׂא [?], & יִשָּׂא [?] exactorem aget, pro יִשָּׂא [?], fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad. נָשָׂא.
יַשִּׁיא [?] decipiet, יַשִּׁיאֲךָ [?] decipiet te, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. נָשָׂא.
וַיִּשְׁבֶּנּוּ [?] reducet eum, וַיִּשְׁבֵם [?] & reduxit eos, וַיִּשְׁבְּרוּ [?] & reduxerunt eum, יִשְׁבֵּנִי [?] reducent me, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. & 3. pl. m. aff. à 3. f. m. יִשְׁב; Rad. שׁוּב.
יִשִּׂיגוּן [?] assequentur, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. parag. Rad. נָשַׂג.
יְשִׁים [?] desolabit, Jer. 49. 20. (pro יְשִׁים, vel, יְשֻׁם,) fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. שָׁמַם.
יְשִׂימוּ [?] ponet eos, Deut. 7. 15. וַיָּשִׂימֵנִי [?] & posuit me, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. יָשִׂים, aff. R. שׂוּם.

page.notes: Hebrew words are copied from a small, heavily inked scan and are doubtful; each one carries [?]. The running head and page number are read from small, smudged print at the top of the page. Where the scan is too faint to confirm a Hebrew vowel or dagesh pointing, I have given the likely form with [?]. The word "inundabuntur" at the head of the right column is printed in a faded, struck-through type and is transcribed as seen. The Google "Digitized by" watermark at the foot is left out.
